name: com.shentonbrokers/quotes
title: Shenton Brokers insurance quotes
description: Singapore insurance prices in S$: travel, maid, car, motorcycle, home, personal accident.

tools.name: get_travel_quote
tools.description: Prices a trip for every featured insurer. A single-trip quote also lists yearly plans for the same region under annualPlans. Each plan has its insurer, price in S$ with GST, the date the price was checked, excess, key cover limits and a buy link. Prices come from the broker's stored price tables for Singapore. No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

countries.description: Destination. Several values are separated by commas.

cruise.description: Going on a cruise. "no" when not given.

destination.description: Where the trip goes: a country name such as "Japan", or several separated by commas ("Japan, Korea").

days.description: Trip length in days, counting the day of leaving and the day of return.

leaving.description: Days from today until the trip starts. 30 when not given. Or give departDate and returnDate.

annual.description: "yes" for a plan that covers every trip in a year. Give region with it.

ages.description: The travellers' ages. Read and noted in the reply. The stored prices are by number of adults and children, not by age.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

tools.name: get_maid_quote

No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

helperDob.description: Your helper's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

bondWaiver.description: Security bond waiver. "no" when not given.

months.description: Cover period in months: 14 for a one-year work permit, 26 for two years.

waiver.description: The security bond waiver. With it, the insurer usually cannot ask the employer to repay the S$5,000 bond.

renewal.description: "yes" when the helper's contract is being renewed, "no" for a new helper. Read and noted in the reply. The stored prices are the same for both.

country.description: The helper's home country. Read, but no insurer prices on it.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

meritCertificate.description: Certificate of Merit. "no" when not given.

car.description: The make and model in words, such as "Honda Vezel" or "Toyota Corolla Altis 1.6".

experience.description: Years the driver has held a licence.

married.description: Whether the main driver is married.

tools.name: explain_product
tools.description: A plain summary of what a product covers and does not cover in Singapore, and what the law or the Ministry of Manpower requires. It recommends no plan and no insurer.

tools.name: create_buy_link
tools.description: The buy link for one plan of a quote. Give the quote's quoteId and the plan: its number in the quote, its reference (such as SB-7K3F9Q-2) or its name. The link leads to the insurer's checkout through the broker, so the sale is recorded under the broker's code. The sale is recorded under the broker's code only when the buyer opens the link unchanged.

quoteId.description: The quoteId of a quote, such as SB-7K3F9Q.

plan.description: The plan's number in the quote ("1" for the first), its reference, or its plan name.
